Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile.properties

Class ParquetFileMetadata

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile.properties.ParquetFileMetadata
public class ParquetFileMetadata extends Object
ParquetFileMetadata describes the contents of a Parquet file using the information that the writer stored in the file's footer.

    • getFormatVersion

      public int getFormatVersion()
      Return the version of the Parquet format that the writer declared in the footer. This is 1 or 2. It is not a reliable guide to the features used in the file since many writers always set it to 1. See also getDataPageVersions(), getEncodings() and getTypeAnnotationStyle().
      Returns:
      version number
